_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score 54 sits at Complacency edge inside a documented coil (only 29% of windows move ±2); dead flows and crowded positioning are stress but Fed liquidity + neutral F&G/VIX keep the base case as no rung change.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst clearly calls HOLD/Complacency; narrative supplies no forward phase or direction
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-54 and BTC drifts without impulsive ETF flow or vol break
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G <46 with pinned flows/extreme dvol (drop to Anxiety) or flows rebound + F&G >63 (lift to Hope)
